// Parameters:                                                                      //
//                                                                         			//
// [ID]int 					= The ID of the object.                                 //
// [NAME (LANG)]string 		= The name of the engine in the respective language.   	//
// [DATE](MONTH) (YEAR) 	= The date when the engine is available.     			//
// [GENRE](ID)				= The specialized genre.         						//
// [PLATFORM](ID)			= The specialized platform.      						//
// [PRICE]int				= How much the engine costs.                 			//
// [SHARE]int				= Profit sharing.       								//
//                                                                                  //
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
